## Pricing (INR, one-time)
- Static website: Basic ₹9,999 (1–3 pages), Standard ₹14,999 (4–7 pages), Premium from ₹19,999 (8+ pages)
- Dynamic website with admin panel: Basic ₹19,999, Standard ₹25,999, Premium from ₹39,999
- Domain, hosting and 1 year of support included with every plan
- Optional care plans: ₹499, ₹999, ₹1,999 per month (yearly billing saves 2 months)
